summary: Ansible-base 2.10 makes invalid boolean keyword values such as 'yes-' raise an error instead of silently returning False, and adds the ansible_processor_nproc fact for vCPUs available to processes.
questions: Why does diff: yes- now fail instead of being false?
How can I get the number of CPUs usable by processes from facts?

answer_card.title: Boolean keyword validation and ansible_processor_nproc
answer_card.answer_md:
- Boolean keywords now **error** on invalid strings. Before, e.g. `diff: yes-` silently became `False`. Use real booleans (`true`/`false`).
- New fact **`ansible_processor_nproc`**: number of vCPUs available to processes (falls back to vCPUs available to the scheduler).
